ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L561-1 to L561-57 (AML/CFT and UBO declaration obligations) and L562-1 et seq. (asset freezing — gel des avoirs); Loi n° 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II); Décret n° 2016-1634 of 1 December 2016 (UBO declaration regime); Ordonnance n° 2020-115 of 12 February 2020 (UBO registration at the Registre National des Entreprises — RNE, managed by INPI); French Commercial Code Articles L123-13, L820-1, R123-39 and L233-3 (control criteria); Règlement (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR) as applicable to UBO data; TRACFIN operates as the French Financial Intelligence Unit.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (with controlled access for AML/CFT obliged entities such as banks, notaries and lawyers under Article L561-2-2 CMF; public access restricted following the CJEU judgment of 22 November 2022)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961, in force for France since 24 January 1965) for member states; consular legalization at the French Embassy or Consulate for non-member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each natural-person shareholder and of each appointed manager (gérant)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport authority of the country of origin or a recognized notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as specified above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company, telecommunications provider or issuing bank in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as specified above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, incumbency and good standing of any corporate shareholder (extrait de registre) and its organic structure chart
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the corporate shareholder's country (e.g., Companies House, ACRA, CRA, HK CR)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as specified above

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming the origin of funds for the proposed share capital contribution (attestation d'origine des fonds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank in the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for member states) or consular legalization; banks may additionally require the French notary's independent verification of the letter's execution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn French translation of all non-French documents (traduction assermentée) including powers of attorney, passports, proof of address and corporate certificates

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, managers and UBOs against: (1) French national asset-freeze orders (gel des avoirs, Article L562-3 CMF, issued by the Ministry of the Economy and Finance/DG Trésor); (2) EU consolidated financial sanctions lists (Council Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 and 765/2006 as amended) and UN Security Council sanctions; (3) OFAC SDN/Near-SDN and US State Department lists, considered market best practice given USD SWIFT wire settlements; (4) TRACFIN typology alerts and the High Authority for Transparency in Public Life (HATVP) PEP databases; (5) World Bank and EBRD debarment lists as institutional best practice. PEPs under Article L561-10 CMF are subject to enhanced due diligence irrespective of jurisdiction of residence; documented origin of funds is required for all capital contributions; UBO identity and control-structure records must be retained for at least five years after cessation of the relationship (Article L561-33 CMF). Although this manufacturing activity is classified Low_Risk_Standard, the establishment of the corporate relationship triggers at least standard due diligence; simplified due diligence under Article L561-13 CMF may not be invoked where foreign corporate shareholders or high-value shipments are present.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) administered by the INPI, feeding the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE), with public data accessible via https://data.inpi.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate denomination (dénomination sociale) must be written in Latin script; French accents and diacritical marks (é, è, ê, à, ç) must be reproduced exactly as registered. Names in non-Latin scripts (e.g., Chinese, Japanese, Korean characters) are not accepted by the RNE; an official romanized/transliterated version (e.g., pinyin) is mandatory and may be supplemented by one or more Latin-script trade names (enseignes). The name must not be contrary to French public policy (ordre public) or to the protection of the French language under Loi n° 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Toubon Law), and a foreign-language denomination must have a sufficiently distinctive or descriptive character so as not to mislead consumers as to the nature, origin or legal form of the company.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: République, État, Gouvernement, Préfecture, Mairie, Police, Gendarmerie, Armée, Justice — official/public-authority terms requiring prior ministerial or prefectoral authorization
Banque, Crédit, Finance, Épargne, Change, Assurance, Réassurance, Mutuelle, Fonds de pension — regulated financial or insurance terms requiring prior ACPR/AMF authorization
Avocat, Notaire, Huissier, Expert-Comptable, Commissaire aux Comptes, Géomètre — regulated professional designations prohibited unless the company holds the corresponding professional qualification
SAS, SARL, EURL, SA, SCI, SNC, SCA, SCOP — legal-form acronyms that do not match the intended SARL legal form or that may mislead as to the company's actual structure
Croix-Rouge, Poste, Université, Académie, Institut de France, Chambre de Commerce, Bourse — protected public or institutional titles requiring prior authorization or holding of the underlying right
France, Paris, Union Européenne, République — when used in a manner that falsely implies official accreditation, state origin or public approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: 1. Rejection is notified electronically through the guichet unique portal within approximately 24-48 hours with the statutory grounds (identity or confusing similarity with an existing RNE company name or trademark, or a prohibited token). 2. The applicant may immediately resubmit the same incorporation form with an amended denomination; no additional statutory fee is charged for the modification, and the legal announcement (JAL) and articles of association must be revised accordingly. 3. If rejection is based on third-party prior rights, the applicant may: (a) obtain a written coexistence consent from the prior right holder; (b) initiate opposition against a potentially unused prior French/EU trademark under Article L712-4 of the French Intellectual Property Code; or (c) apply to the commercial chamber of the Tribunal Judiciaire de Paris to compel registration. 4. Where rejection arises from a sensitive token (e.g., Banque, Assurance), the applicant must obtain prior written authorization from the ACPR, AMF or the competent ministry and annex that authorization to the resubmission. 5. Refusals by the INPI on trademark grounds may be appealed to the Cour d'appel de Paris within 2 months of notification; RNE registration refusals may be challenged by administrative recours (recours gracieux to the INPI Director, then recours contentieux before the administrative court) within 2 months; simultaneous commercial litigation before the Tribunal Judiciaire de Paris is available where the dispute concerns the RCS registration itself. 6. The name acquires full legal protection upon RNE registration; subsequent infringement or passing-off claims are heard by the commercial courts.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Authorized subject to strict conditions. A French SARL must maintain a registered office (siège social) in France. A virtual office is permitted only through (i) a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation holding a prefectoral agrément under Articles L123-10-1 to L123-11-2 of the French Commercial Code) or (ii) the manager's residential address, which is limited to a maximum of five years unless renewed by relocation. For the zinc alloy die-casting and tampo-printing business, the virtual office is acceptable as the legal seat and for administrative domiciliation, but the actual manufacturing site must be a physically identifiable and compliant industrial premises, as DGCCRF, customs and URSSAF controls require access to production, inventory and import/export documentation. The registered office must be open for service of process and inspection during normal business hours.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-heightened for the manufacturing/import model: the cumulative annual probability of at least one unannounced on-site visit is assessed at 20-30%, comprising URSSAF employment controls (Article L8272-4 of the French Labour Code), DGCCRF conformity checks under EU Toy Safety Directive 2009/48/EC as applied to 1:18-scale collectible replicas if intended or marketed in a way that attracts children under 14, customs post-clearance audits on imported raw zinc alloy and finished goods, and periodic environmental inspection of die-casting emissions under ICPE registration requirements. Unannounced direct tax audits in the first fiscal year are estimated below 5%, but increase materially if VAT refunds are claimed. Premises, payroll records and production documents must be maintained in a constant state of inspection readiness.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated tariff for legal announcements — approximately €121.74 excluding VAT for companies with share capital up to €750,000, plus publication-specific supplements; prevailing market range €130-250

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translation (traduction assermentée) of foreign shareholder documents (passports, proof of address, bank reference letters, corporate certificates)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur assermenté) registered with the competent French Cour d'appel or Chamber of Commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of €40-80 per page for sworn translators operating in the Paris and Lyon markets; estimate based on 3-5 pages of heterogeneous documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization fees for five foreign-origin documents (powers of attorney, passports, address proof, corporate certificate, bank letter)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of each country of origin (e.g., US Secretary of State, UK FCDO, HK High Court Registry, corresponding ministries) or French consulate for non-Hague states

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard SARL incorporation with foreign shareholders: fixed fee of €700-1,500 excluding VAT, depending on firm reputation and bilingual drafting requirements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Business domiciliation (virtual office) contract for the registered office — first annual term

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of €60-100 per month for commercial domiciliation services in Paris and regional business centers, including mail forwarding and reception; annualized at €750

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter and origin-of-funds confirmation issued by the shareholder's foreign bank for the capital contribution

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank service charge, where levied, typically US$25-75 per reference letter; travel/notarial verification expenses excluded

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL rules); Implementing Decree Articles R.223-1 et seq.; Civil Code Articles 1832-1835; Order No. 2021-1389 of 22 October 2021 (unified electronic Guichet Unique filing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) of the department where the registered office is located; all constitutive filings are transmitted centrally through the INPI Guichet Unique portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) together with the standardized electronic declaration of incorporation (formulaire M0) lodged via the Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital: the stated capital is freely fixed in the Articles (Art. L.223-2). At least 20% of cash contributions must be paid up at incorporation; the balance must be released within five years (Art. L.223-7). The paid-up cash portion is blocked in a dedicated deposit account with a French bank or the Caisse des Depots et Consignations until the registration certificate (Extrait Kbis) is obtained. In-kind contributions are fully vested in the company at formation and must be appraised by a commissaire aux apports unless the value does not exceed EUR 30,000 and all members unanimously waive the appraisal (Arts. L.223-9 and L.223-13).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS - SARL. 1) The final Articles of Association, including the corporate object (zinc alloy die-casting and tampo printing of 1:18 scale automotive replicas) and the stated share capital of EUR [...], are unanimously approved. 2) All issued shares are subscribed; not less than 20% of each cash contribution is paid into a blocked bank account, evidenced by the deposit certificate. 3) The registered office is fixed at [address], France. 4) [Name] is appointed Gerant for an unlimited term with full powers under Article L.223-18 of the Commercial Code. 5) The Gerant is authorized to complete publicity, Guichet Unique filing and all ancillary registration formalities. Adopted unanimously on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Clearance and Drafting of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI National Data Verification Service (data.inpi.fr) with drafting support from a French avocat or notaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Query the INPI registers to confirm the proposed company name (denomination sociale) and protected trademarks are available; draft the Articles of Association containing the corporate object (ISIC 3240 zinc alloy die-casting and tampo printing), the stated capital, the registered office, the duration, the share subscription terms, and the Gerant appointment clause. Have all founders sign the statutory document; an advance copy is retained for later registration.
required_dossiers: Three signed originals of the draft Articles of Association
INPI name/trademark availability search output
Identity document and proof of address for each founding shareholder
Foreign corporate registry extract or IFU certificate for any corporate member
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused or found conflicting, select a secondary denomination, amend the company-name clause of the Articles, and re-run the INPI verification. No re-notarial step is required unless the corporate object or capital structure is also modified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocking of Share Capital in a French Depository Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French authorized credit institution or the Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary incorporation account and transfer the subscribed cash capital from the founders' bank accounts. Obtain the certificate of deposit of funds (certificat de depot des fonds) confirming that at least 20% of each cash contribution has been paid. The funds are blocked and may be withdrawn only after the Kbis extract is issued.
required_dossiers: Certificate of deposit of funds issued by the bank or CDC
List of subscribers with the amount contributed by each
Identity documents of the persons making the capital contribution
SWIFT or bank transfer advice evidencing the remittance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the transaction under AML/KYC rules, provide a source-of-funds declaration and supporting bank statements. Alternatively redeposit the capital with another authorized institution or the CDC; the blocking regime remains identical and no filing deadline is lost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Incorporation Notice in a Legal Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal-notice newspaper (Journal d'Annonces Legales - JAL) of the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Place the standard incorporation announcement (avis de constitution) in an approved JAL. The notice must state the corporate form (SARL), denomination, stated capital, registered office, company object, duration, and identity of the Gerant. Obtain the attestation of publication (attestation de parution) which will accompany the registration file.
required_dossiers: Certificate of deposit of funds
Corporate-object clause from the final Articles
Proof of registered-office address
Gerant's identity and declaration of non-conviction
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected gazette declines or delays the notice, brief another authorized JAL of the same department. Corrected wording is published by way of a rectificatif and the corrected attestation is resubmitted within the registry cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Incorporation Dossier at the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the single digital incorporation form (M0) on the INPI portal, attach the signed Articles and all supporting certificates, pay the registry fee online by bank card, and certify the filing. The platform automatically routes the dossier to the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office.
required_dossiers: Completed and digitally signed M0 form
Scanned copy of the signed Articles of Association
Attestation de parution issued by the legal gazette
Certificat de depot des fonds from the bank or CDC
Gerant's declaration of non-conviction and consent to office
Proof of registered-office occupation or lease
Bank identity statement (RIB) of the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where an attachment is missing or defective, the Guichet Unique issues a request for completion (demande de complement) allowing fifteen working days for correction. Upload the rectified item and confirm the amendment in the portal; the initial filing priority is preserved and the dossier re-enters the review queue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal Review and Issuance of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registrar legally verifies the Articles, the capital payment evidence, the publication attestation, and the legitimacy of the registered office. Upon approval the company is registered in the trade and companies register (RCS) and the official Extract Kbis is issued, which constitutes conclusive proof of the company's legal existence and capacity to act.
required_dossiers: Complete digital dossier transmitted by the Guichet Unique
Proof of payment of the registry fee
Original certificate of deposit when requested by the registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues a query or temporary suspension, cure the stated deficiency (missing document, ambiguous clause, incompatible appointments) and resubmit the corrected document through the Guichet Unique within the prescribed deadline. Unlawful refusals may be appealed to the supervisory judge (juge commis a la surveillance du registre).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Social, Tax and Economic Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, DREETS (labor administration), and the INPI/RNE business data repository
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the SIREN and SIRET numbers issued on the Kbis, finalize the company's registration with the social security contribution agency (URSSAF), open the employer account, verify the VAT and tax status with the competent tax office, and complete the Gerant's remuneration and social affiliation formalities. Confirm the registration of the economic activity and update any industry classification codes.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis issued by the greffe
Bank identity statement (RIB)
Identity documents of the Gerant
Gerant compensation or employment contract decision
VAT registration confirmation request
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the benefit fund or tax office queries the declarations, provide the Kbis and the tax domiciliation certificate to confirm the legal existence. Completion of the social declarations within eight days of the Kbis guarantees retroactive effect and avoids late-registration penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Prefecture of the department - DREAL (Direction Regionale de l'Environnement, de l'Amenagement et du Logement), ICPE unit, acting jointly with the DREETS labor inspectorate and the departmental fire and rescue service (SDIS) for operational clearances.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Arrete prefectoral d'enregistrement or recepisse de declaration under the ICPE regime (Installations Classees pour la Protection de l'Environnement) - Rubrique 2534 covering non-ferrous metal alloy melting and casting, supplemented by a building occupancy permit and CE conformity attestations of the die-casting and tampo printing machinery.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecological Transition - Regional Direction DREAL, acting under Book V of the French Environmental Code (Code de l'environnement).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category D (Declaration) or EN (Enregistrement). A small-scale zinc alloy die-casting workshop operates under the declaration or registration regime with a simplified impact notice or technical registration dossier; a full environmental impact assessment with public inquiry (Category A authorization) is triggered only when melting capacity or VOC emissions exceed the ICPE authorization thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 5.5-8.5, total suspended solids less than 30 mg/L, COD less than 125 mg/L, zinc less than 1.5 mg/L. Atmospheric emissions: stack dust below 150 mg/Nm3. VOC: solvent management plan with capture efficiency not less than 85% and abatement not less than 70% for tampo printing lines. Hazardous metal chips, slags and used inks are tracked under the regulated waste duty-of-care with bordereau de suivi; finished collectible replicas must meet EN 71-3 heavy-metal migration limits where subject to toy or youth-product classification.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: submission of the technical fire dossier and SDIS approval before commissioning, including furnace fire separation, evacuation routes and automatic extinguishing systems. Structural clearance: certified technical controller inspection of the roof, foundations and machine anchorages. Occupational clearance: DREETS workplace inspection covering CE-marked machinery, electrical installation verification certificate, noise action plan at the 80 dB(A) exposure threshold, personal protective equipment programs, and the single risk assessment document (DUER) with medical surveillance through the medecine du travail service.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), France — main taxation portal: impots.gouv.fr; professional filings via pro.impots.gouv.fr; company incorporations and formalities via Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident entities establishing a French SARL must file formation documents through the Guichet Unique / Centre de Formalités des Entreprises (CFE). Upon incorporation, the company receives its SIREN, SIRET, and Kbis extract from the Register of Commerce and Companies. The DGFiP automatically assigns a fiscal identification number and, once the entity confirms taxable activity, the company applies for an intra-community VAT number (n° TVA intracommunautaire) via the DGFiP online portal. If no French permanent establishment is created, the foreign entity may be required to appoint a VAT tax representative (représentant fiscal) and apply for direct VAT registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL is by default subject to French corporation tax (impôt sur les sociétés) at entity level. Under Article 239 bis AA of the French Tax Code (CGI), an eligible small/mid-size SARL may elect to be taxed as a fiscally transparent partnership subject to income tax (IR). Additionally, an option for group tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) exists under Article 223 A CGI. France has no generic 'check-the-box' election; hybrid mismatch arrangements are constrained by EU ATAD directives.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA), the French VAT system
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory VAT registration: for sales of goods, €91,000 (with an €85,000 lower threshold for certain cases); for services, €36,800 (2025 thresholds per Article 293 B CGI).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) is being phased in through the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF). Large enterprises must comply from 1 September 2026, SMEs/micro from 1 September 2027. Invoices must be sent via API or certified dematerialization platforms; e-reporting of cross-border data to DGFiP is required. Additionally, cash registers used by retailers must be certified against the French anti-fraud law.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sales of goods physically dispatched from French territory to a destination outside the European Union qualify for the 0% VAT rate ('exportation') under Articles 258 and 262(I) CGI. To apply, the VAT-exempt supplier must hold sufficient documentary evidence of export (customs declaration and transport documentation) and maintain the records for the statutory retention period. Certain services rendered to non-EU B2B customers fall outside the scope of French VAT under place-of-supply rules and may similarly qualify for zero-rating or non-taxation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration (DAU / EXA) indicating the exporter of record
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR consignment note
Commercial invoice with express export reference
Proof of goods exit from the EU (e.g., electronic customs movement record or port/airport exit confirmation)
Inward Remittance Certificate (attestation de rapatriement des recettes) evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Packing list and transport insurance or freight documents
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Claims for export zero-rating are scrutinized during VAT audits. If export evidence is missing or false, the VAT exempted is clawed back by reassessment, plus monthly late interest of 0.40%. Penalties range from 40% of the reassessed duty for wilful failure (manquement délibéré) to 80% for fraudulent manipulation or abuse of right. Criminal tax fraud sanctions under Article 1741 of the French Tax Code may include up to five years of imprisonment and a fine of €500,000.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, with foreign exchange policy coordination by the Direction Générale du Trésor (Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full current and capital account convertibility under the EU Treaty and OECD liberalization codes. No material profit repatriation hurdles for French resident SARLs other than standard corporate tax withholding if applicable and BNCT customs/statistical reporting. Dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are generally subject to a 30% withholding tax, reduced under tax treaties; capital repatriation via share capital reduction or liquidation is free of FX restriction but requires notarial and legal formalities. All transactions exceeding €50,000 require declaration to Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistical purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory export proceeds surrender or conversion ratio exists in France. Export receipts may be held in foreign currency or converted freely; however, the exporter must repatriate proceeds to the EU within the invoicing terms and report export flows through the Banque de France's cross-border statistics (Bank of France 'Reporting of cross-border payments'). Late or missing declarations may expose the entity to administrative penalties, not FX conversion requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; Capital Escrow Account available via depository agreement
Operational Account; dedicated Euro treasury accounts for commercial transactions
Operational Account; trade finance and cash management clearing house structures
Operational Account; regional cooperative bank for SME cash management

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for EU-authorized Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) under the PSD2 passport. Legally permissible only if the EMI is registered with the ACPR (Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority) or holds a valid EU passport into France. Offshore non-EU EMIs cannot provide euro-denominated French IBANs or access SEPA/instant clearing without a French branch or agent arrangement; direct onboarding as a cash-management rail is generally unviable for trade settlement above de minimis thresholds.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For French-incorporated SARLs, banks generally require the legal representative or a duly authorized signatory to attend a physical identity verification at the branch during initial onboarding; remote opening is possible only for certain digital banks and existing EU-established entities using secure video verification subject to ACPR guidance. If the SARL is owned by non-resident individuals, enhanced due diligence may require a physical meeting at an embassy or apostilled power of attorney to waive the personal appearance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete Registre National des Beneficiaires Effectifs (RBE) extract, proof of identity of each ultimate beneficial owner, personal residence proof, and a legitimate business-purpose narrative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk geographic exposure of shareholders or counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds documentation (tax returns, audited financials, sale contracts), legal entity structure diagram, breakdown of transaction rationale, and confirmation of no sanctions nexus (OFAC/EU/ONU).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PayPal or online payment volume inconsistent with role of die-cast collectibles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial agreements, ICP/Tampo printing order logs, shipping carrier records, customs export declarations, and e-commerce marketplace transaction evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital escrow funding from related foreign entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolutions, intercompany loan agreements, shareholder capital contribution declarations, transfer-pricing documentation, and bank reference letters from remitting institution.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer via SWIFT using the SARL's French IBAN and BIC; the incoming payment must be tagged with the purpose code 'N1 – Capital transaction' (Direct Investment / Capital Contribution / Shareholder Loan) and supported by a signed shareholder resolution and capital increase or loan deed. For payments of €50,000 or above, the bank will require a 'Déclaration de Transaction Financière' (cross-border flow report) confirmed by the entity; failure to provide the underlying contract may delay crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 / MT202 for direct supplier payments, and Documentary Letters of Credit (UCP 600) for significant die-casting mold and raw-material settlements. For low-value remittances to EU suppliers, SEPA Instant Credit Transfer offers immediate settlement. All outbound payments must carry ECC (European Community Classification) purpose codes, typically 'N8 – Trade in goods' for raw material and 'N9 – Services' for contract manufacturing or licensing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/CNY forward contracts (Vanilla Forwards) with licensed French banks
FX swaps (swap de change) for liquidity matching
Cross-currency swaps for long term liability hedging
NDFs only when the underlying currency lacks official EUR convertibility or is an offshore illiquid currency; subject to EMIR reporting and ACPR authorization.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts approval and public filing: balance sheet, profit and loss account, notes, management report, and profit-appropriation resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés via the Guichet Unique des Formalités
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months after fiscal year close; deposit within 1 month after approval. For a calendar-year SARL, final filing must occur by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is punishable by a fine of EUR 1,500 (EUR 3,000 for a legal entity) and the Court Registrar may apply for administrative strike-off from the RCS if filings are persistently omitted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return and liasse fiscale: Form 2065 plus 2050 series schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the professional online portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year SARL, due by 3 May of the following year. For a non-calendar fiscal year, the return is due within 3 months after the fiscal year close unless another threshold applies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or late filing triggers a 10% penalty on the assessed tax, or 15% after a formal notice; late-payment interest at 0.2% per month is added, and additional reassessment may follow.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Updated beneficial ownership declaration and statutory register audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Guichet Unique des Formalités
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: no separate annual filing is imposed; any change in beneficial ownership, including a share transfer, must be declared within 30 days of the change. A full register audit is recommended alongside the annual accounts.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or missing UBO declarations are punishable by a civil fine of up to EUR 5,000, increased to EUR 15,000 for a legal entity; repeated non-compliance may also trigger RCS strike-off action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) if at the year-end it exceeds any two of the following three thresholds: (1) total balance sheet EUR 4,000,000; (2) turnover excluding tax EUR 8,000,000; (3) average number of employees 50. Audit exemption is available when the entity remains below the thresholds for two consecutive years.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) as codified in the Code de Commerce; consolidation, where applicable, follows IFRS for regulated groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: French law does not require an annual anniversary confirmation of UBO ownership. The SARL must declare beneficial owners at registration and within 30 days of any change, including any share transfer that alters ownership percentages or control. The written and evidence-backed UBO declaration file should be refreshed and internal reconciliation completed each year with the shareholder register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders and share transfer movements (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of shareholder meetings and written decisions (registre des décisions d'associés)
Register of composition and changes in corporate officers (gérants)
Beneficial ownership declaration file (dossier des bénéficiaires effectifs)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 to USD 22,000, depending on business size and activity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate for SMEs on first €42,500; R&D tax credit (up to 30% of eligible expenses); accelerated depreciation

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1200A (Déclaration de résultat de l'impôt sur les sociétés) via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g. 15 May for calendar year ending 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit or loss before corporate income tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only French-source income; attach TRC for treaty relief

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Impôt sur les sociétés calculé

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding taxes on dividends, royalties or interest may be credited against liability

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 0.5% of tax due per month (maximum 5%); daily surcharge 0.2%; criminal penalties for evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12.8% (plus 17.2% social charges for non-EU; reduced by double tax treaties)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Demande de réduction de retenue à la source) to tax authorities with beneficial ownership and DTA documentation; administrative DTA relief process
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory (0% under many treaties including EU); Interest: 25% statutory (0% EU, 10% other)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million consolidated group turnover for Master File; €7.5 million for Local File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations apply to certain preferential regimes; substance requirements under French tax code and DAC6

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful underreporting of income or false tax declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to 80% of evaded tax plus interest; criminal prosecution with up to 5 years imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for tax debts; disqualification, fines and imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining artificial entities without real operations or decision-making authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of transactions; penalties up to €500,000; potential criminal liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal restitution orders, travel bans and up to 5 years imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to identify beneficial owners or report suspicious transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €1 million or 5% of annual turnover; criminal sanctions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, imprisonment and disqualification from corporate roles
